item.title: Reynard v0.17.0
item.description:
Reynard 0.17.0 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.16.0...0.17.0
### Improvements - The native text input integration has been rewritten from scratch, so typing now feels truly native, supports nearly all iOS text editing behaviors, and is significantly more stable.
### New Features - The address bar now automatically focuses for input on new tab pages when using a physical keyboard. - You can now cycle between tabs using the Ctrl + Tab and Shift + Ctrl + Tab keyboard shortcuts.
### Bug Fixes - Fixed an issue where a tab would appear blank after closing another tab in the tab overview. - Fixed an issue where dragging the iPad floating keyboard or shortcut bar would push the web view upward. - Fixed an issue where taps would sometimes land in the wrong spot on some iframe elements when the scroll to hide toolbar is enabled. - Fixed several UI issues.
### Engine
Updated Gecko to [157.0.1](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_157_0_1_RELEASE) (released Oct 6, 2026).

item.title: Reynard v0.15.0
item.description:
Reynard 0.15.0 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.14.1...0.15.0
### New Features - Added support for printing a webpage or an online PDF viewed in the browser, accessible as a **Print** option in the share sheet or with the Command + P keyboard shortcut. - You can now see which tab is playing audio and mute tabs directly from the address bar. - You can now configure whether Reader Mode is shown automatically for a specific website or for all websites. - Built-in add-on pages, such as those that provide a custom new tab appearance, can now be set as your new tab page. - For links that open in a new tab automatically or from the context menu, you can now return to the opener tab using the back button, or by swiping from the left edge of the screen to the right.
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - JIT can now be enabled on iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. - Greatly reduced memory and power usage when the camera is active. - The Command + W keyboard shortcut now activates the adjacent tab instead of the most recently opened one. - If you set the last tab to show on startup, the browser now loads its URL immediately instead of after a short delay. - The list of recently closed tabs now clears when you remove browsing history in the browser settings. - Fixed a regression where Reader Mode’s serif font would be used as the default serif font for all websites. - Fixed numerous bugs and improved UI animations.
### Translations Added Vietnamese translation.
### Engine Updated Gecko to [156.0.1](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_156_0_1_RELEASE) (released Sep 22, 2026).
